reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and use it every day. Nothing here shows me these co-workers actually finish the work in my CRM and inbox instead of handing me more drafts to fix, so I'm not adding another subscription on a promise.
objection: Will it really do the work, or just give me drafts I still have to fix? And what does 100 credits a month actually get me? I can't tell if that's a week of use or a day.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own CRM and mailbox where the Sales or Support co-worker clears a real backlog without me editing everything, plus a clear answer on what one credit buys.
